sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你们制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: All right, today we're going to talk about counseling, which is Season 7, Episode 2.
sentences.zh: 好了，今天我们要聊的是第七季第二集《心理咨询》。

sentences.en: But first, Ange, I feel like I want to share with our podcast listeners the morning that we had getting here.
sentences.zh: 但在开始之前，安吉，我觉得我想和我们的播客听众分享一下我们今天早上来这儿的经历。

sentences.en: We had quite the text thread going this morning.
sentences.zh: 我们今天早上在群聊里聊得可热闹了。

sentences.en: With Sam and Cassie, you and me.
sentences.zh: 有山姆、卡西，还有你和我。

sentences.en: I can't believe I am congested again.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信我又鼻塞了。

sentences.en: This is, you know, kids going to camps, and I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，孩子们去参加夏令营什么的，我也不知道。

sentences.en: We're bringing all the stuff home.
sentences.zh: 我们把各种病菌都带回家了。

sentences.en: So this morning, y'all were checking in with me.
sentences.zh: 所以今天早上，你们都在关心我。

sentences.en: You're like, Jenna, are you okay to record?
sentences.zh: 你们问我，珍娜，你还能录音吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm going to rally.
Yeah, I was like, I don't bring enough to this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我说，我不能给播客拖后腿。

sentences.en: I'm going to bring Food Boys name.
sentences.zh: 我要带上“食物男孩”的名字。

sentences.en: And, you know, Cassie and I are looking pretty good this morning.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，卡西和我今天早上看起来状态不错。

sentences.en: We both just finished off the donut.
sentences.zh: 我们俩刚把甜甜圈吃完。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, they have donuts in the lobby today.
sentences.zh: 噢，对，今天大厅里有甜甜圈。

sentences.en: I want to point out, Jenna's almost horizontal.
sentences.zh: 我想指出的是，珍娜现在几乎是横躺着的。
她几乎是半躺在椅子上。

sentences.en: She's pulled another chair next to her chair so she can recline.
sentences.zh: 她在自己的椅子旁边又拉了一把椅子，好让自己能躺下来。

sentences.en: So after Sam and I are both like, we're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 在山姆和我表示我们能行之后。

sentences.en: I reached into my closet to grab my office lady's hoodie,
sentences.zh: 我伸手去衣柜拿我的《办公室女士》连帽衫时，

sentences.en: and I sliced my finger open on a broken edge of my plastic hanger.
sentences.zh: 手指被塑料衣架的破损边缘划破了。

sentences.en: So then I'm like, you know what?
So I'm driving in to work and driving my daughter to camp firSt.
sentences.zh: 当时我正开车去上班，先送我女儿去夏令营。

sentences.en: And there was this big sort of that moment where someone cut in front of the line of cars
sentences.zh: 就在这时，突然有人强行插进车队里，

sentences.en: that were headed toward this one exit.
sentences.zh: 大家都正排队往同一个出口走。

sentences.en: Everything slowed down, and I had to slam on the brakes.
sentences.zh: 车流瞬间慢了下来，我不得不猛踩刹车。

sentences.en: But I could tell around me that, like, there was not enough space for everybody.
sentences.zh: 但我能感觉到周围的空间根本不够大家缓冲。

sentences.en: Did the brake noise before it?
Like, were you know what's going on?
sentences.zh: 就是，你知道发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: I just could feel, like, the time and space around me.
sentences.zh: 我只是能感觉到周围的时间和空间，

sentences.en: And I said out loud to my daughter, I said, I think we're going to be in an accident.
sentences.zh: 我当时大声对女儿说，我说，我觉得我们要出车祸了。

sentences.en: And then the person behind us ran into us.
sentences.zh: 然后后面那个人就撞上了我们。

sentences.en: It was a fender bender to call it an accident.
sentences.zh: 说是车祸，其实就是个小剐蹭。

sentences.en: And then, of course, it's L.A., so I'm expecting this person is going to take off.
sentences.zh: 而且，毕竟是在洛杉矶，我当时以为那个人会逃逸。

sentences.en: But I'm like, no way he's pulling over.
sentences.zh: 但我心想，他不可能靠边停车的。

sentences.en: He gets out of his car.
He's wearing a Vote for Pedro t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件印着“投票给佩德罗”的T恤。
噢，是《拿破仑炸药》的粉丝。
我们检查了我的保险杠。

sentences.en: We're all going to be fine.
Guess where he was going to go to work?
The Wizarding World of Harry Potter.
Which we had just been to a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 我们几天前才刚去过那里。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, my gosh.
He had just moved here from Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 他刚从夏威夷搬到这里。

sentences.en: He had borrowed this car from the person he's living with to drive to his job at Wizarding
sentences.zh: 他借了室友的车，正要去哈利波特的魔法世界上班，

sentences.en: You know, they all talk in accents in the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在哈利波特的魔法世界里，他们说话都带着口音。

sentences.en: It's very theatrical, the whole experience.
sentences.zh: 整个体验非常有戏剧感。

sentences.en: And I said to him, do they make you speak in accents?
sentences.zh: 我问他，他们会要求你用口音说话吗？

sentences.en: And he said, no, if you have an accent, you can speak in it.
sentences.zh: 他说，不会，如果你有口音，你可以直接用你的口音说。

sentences.en: But he said he does it anyway because he's an aspiring actor and he likes to do voice work.
sentences.zh: 但他又说他还是会刻意模仿，因为他是个有抱负的演员，喜欢做配音工作。

sentences.en: We had a lovely chat on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 我们在路边聊得很开心。

sentences.en: I love the idea that he bumped into Pam from the office and you were excited about his job.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个想法，他碰巧遇到了《办公室》里的帕姆，而你对他的工作很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I was like, tell me everything.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像是，快把一切都告诉我。

sentences.en: No, he did end up recognizing me and I took a photo with him.
sentences.zh: 不，他最后确实认出我了，我还跟他合了影。

sentences.en: So if you know this guy and he tags us, I'll try to find it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你认识这个人，而且他标记了我们，我会试着找出来。

sentences.en: But I love that you were just chatting him up on the side of the road because I would have been there for all of that.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢你在路边跟他搭讪，因为如果我在场，我肯定也会参与其中。

sentences.en: And then I would have been like, what are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 然后我会问，你今天打算做什么？

sentences.en: I was like, well, I should probably go.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，好吧，我大概该走了。

sentences.en: I have to go to work.
I have to drop my daughter off at camp.
sentences.zh: 我得送我女儿去夏令营。

sentences.en: But we're all fine and we're here.
sentences.zh: 但我们都很好，也都在这儿了。

sentences.en: I think I'm maybe good for the day.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我今天大概没问题了。
这就是我早上的题外话。

sentences.en: This episode of Counseling was written by BJ Novak and directed by Jeffrey Blitz.
sentences.zh: 这一集《心理咨询》由BJ·诺瓦克编剧，杰弗里·布里茨执导。

sentences.en: As a punishment for spanking Luke in front of the entire office,
sentences.zh: 因为在整个办公室面前打了卢克的屁股作为惩罚，

sentences.en: Michael must complete six hour-long counseling sessions with Toby.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔必须完成六次为期一小时的托比心理咨询。

sentences.en: Dwight seeks a pretty woman-style revenge on a salesman who snubbed him at the Steamtown Mall.
sentences.zh: 德怀特对一个在蒸汽镇购物中心冷落他的推销员进行了《风月俏佳人》式的报复。

sentences.en: And Pam scams her way into a new job title.
sentences.zh: 帕姆则通过欺骗手段获得了一个新的职位头衔。

sentences.en: I mean, in this episode, I was like, Pam, who are you?
sentences.zh: 我是说，在这一集里，我当时想，帕姆，你是谁啊？

sentences.en: You know, when this happened, it was sort of like one of those controversial character moments.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当这件事发生时，这有点像那种充满争议的角色时刻。

sentences.en: We got a lot of messages about it.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多关于此的消息。

sentences.en: I mentioned that Michael has to do these counseling sessions with Toby.
sentences.zh: 我提到了迈克尔必须和托比进行这些心理咨询。

sentences.en: It's revealed at two minutes and 52 seconds that Toby has a degree in social work from Temple University.
sentences.zh: 在两分五十二秒处显示，托比拥有天普大学的社会工作学位。

sentences.en: I took a picture of it.
He's standing so proudly by it.
sentences.zh: 他站在旁边，看起来特别自豪。

sentences.en: Well, the shot is only two seconds long, but a lot went into getting that diploma because it is a real diploma.
sentences.zh: 虽然那个镜头只有两秒长，但为了拿到那张毕业证可是费了不少功夫，因为那是真的毕业证。

sentences.en: We got a letter from Raymond Betzner in Williamsburg, Virginia, that says this.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一封来自弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的雷蒙德·贝茨纳的信，信上是这么写的。

sentences.en: I was the associate vice president for marketing and communications at Temple University in 2010 and helped get Toby his degree.
sentences.zh: 我曾在2010年担任天普大学市场与传播副校长，并帮忙让托比拿到了学位。

sentences.en: How can Toby be a graduate from Temple University?
sentences.zh: 托比怎么可能是天普大学的毕业生呢？

sentences.en: Oh, well, lady, we got a bunch of mail about, like, when was this happening?
sentences.zh: 哦，女士，我们收到了很多邮件，都在问这到底是什么时候发生的？

sentences.en: Was this before or after he was in the seminary?
sentences.zh: 这发生在他去神学院之前还是之后？

sentences.en: Was it before or after he worked in advertising?
sentences.zh: 是在他做广告工作之前还是之后？

sentences.en: Toby's backstory is much like Andy's.
sentences.zh: 托比的背景故事和安迪的很像。

sentences.en: I got an email one day from a member of the office staff.
sentences.zh: 有一天我收到了一封来自办公室员工的邮件。

sentences.en: I'm retired now and no longer have access to my email, so I can't tell you who exactly it was.
sentences.zh: 我现在退休了，已经无法访问我的邮箱，所以没法告诉你具体是谁发的。

sentences.en: I was told they wanted Toby to have a master's in social work from Temple University and could I make it happen?
sentences.zh: 我被告知他们想让托比拥有天普大学的社会工作硕士学位，问我能不能办到？

sentences.en: And naturally, they needed it faSt.
sentences.zh: 而且理所当然地，他们需要得很快。

sentences.en: If you know anything about higher education, you need to know two things.
sentences.zh: 如果你了解高等教育，你就得知道两件事。

sentences.en: First, we take degrees and diplomas very seriously.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们对学位和毕业证非常重视。

sentences.en: And second, higher education doesn't move quickly.
sentences.zh: 第二，高等教育机构的办事效率并不快。

sentences.en: But I was a fan of the show.
sentences.zh: 但我当时是这部剧的粉丝。

sentences.en: I thought it was worth a shot.
It took calls to the university registrar, the university council,
sentences.zh: 我给学校教务处、校务委员会打了电话，

sentences.en: and the cajoling of several others to clear the path for this to happen.
sentences.zh: 还软磨硬泡了其他人，才为这件事扫清了障碍。

sentences.en: Along the way, I kept getting nervous calls from folks at the office because they needed it soon.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我不断接到办公室人员打来的催促电话，因为他们急需这个。

sentences.en: I will also admit that I tried to get a little something in return for all this effort.
sentences.zh: 我也承认，为了这些努力，我试图换取一点小小的回报。

sentences.en: I wanted to know if Michael and Holly got together before Steve Carell leaves the show.
sentences.zh: 我想知道迈克尔和霍莉在史蒂夫·卡瑞尔离开剧组前会不会在一起。

sentences.en: He says the staff at the office aren't dumb and they didn't let anything out in advance.
sentences.zh: 他说办公室的工作人员并不傻，他们没有提前透露任何消息。

sentences.en: I love that what he wanted was scoop on storylines.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他想要的竟然是剧情内幕。
也不是要什么亲笔签名之类的。

sentences.en: Tell me about Holly and Michael.
sentences.zh: 告诉我霍莉和迈克尔的事。

sentences.en: I'm pleased to say we were able to get the diploma approved and printed and set to California.
sentences.zh: 很高兴告诉大家，我们成功获批并印制了那张毕业证书，还把它寄到了加州。

sentences.en: The photo of Toby pointing to his Temple University School of Social Work diploma
sentences.zh: 托比指着他天普大学社会工作学院毕业证书的那张照片，

sentences.en: was hot on Temple University's social media for weeks.
sentences.zh: 在天普大学的社交媒体上火了好几周。

sentences.en: So, I reached out to Randy Cordray about this, Angela, and he said that the writers had originally
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我为此联系了兰迪·科德雷，他说编剧们最初

sentences.en: considered Wake Forest University for Toby, but when they inquired about getting a degree
sentences.zh: 考虑让托比毕业于维克森林大学，但当他们询问能否获得该校的

sentences.en: in social work, they found out that Wake Forest does not offer a degree in social work,
sentences.zh: 社会工作学位时，发现维克森林大学并不提供社会工作学位，

sentences.en: So, that's when the writers pivoted to Temple and James Carey solved the mystery for Raymond.
sentences.zh: 所以编剧们才转而选择了天普大学，而詹姆斯·凯里为雷蒙德解开了这个谜团。

sentences.en: It was Phil Shea who reached out to him.
Phil Shea sent him a prepaid FedEx envelope to send back two diplomas, and in return,
sentences.zh: 菲尔·谢伊寄给他一个预付邮资的联邦快递信封，让他寄回两张毕业证书，作为回报，

sentences.en: he did send Raymond two Dunder Mifflin hats.
sentences.zh: 他确实寄给了雷蒙德两顶邓德·米夫林的帽子。

sentences.en: So, Raymond, do you still have your Dunder Mifflin hat?
sentences.zh: 那么，雷蒙德，你还有你的邓德·米夫林帽子吗？

sentences.en: Email us a photo of you with your hat.
sentences.zh: 给我们发一张你戴着帽子的照片吧。

sentences.en: Please, Raymond, can we put you in Office Lady's stories?
sentences.zh: 拜托了，雷蒙德，我们可以把你发到《办公室女士》的故事里吗？

sentences.en: Well, I love knowing all of that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很喜欢了解这些信息。

sentences.en: I mean, those little details always blow my mind.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这些小细节总是让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: All right, are you ready for fast fact number two?
sentences.zh: 好了，准备好听第二个速递事实了吗？

sentences.en: All right, this one is a little detail from Pam's storyline of trying to get her new job.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是一个关于帕姆努力找新工作这一剧情的小细节。

sentences.en: We got a lot of mail from folks in Australia.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多来自澳大利亚观众的来信。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, because she talks about Canberra.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的，因为她提到了堪培拉。

sentences.en: We got mail from Kimmy G in Canberra, Australia, who said,
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自澳大利亚堪培拉的基米·G的来信，她说：

sentences.en: I grew up in the Barra.
And this is just so random because Canberra is a tiny, freezing, often-missed city in Australia.
sentences.zh: 这真的很随机，因为堪培拉是澳大利亚一个很小、很冷、经常被忽略的城市。

sentences.en: Most people don't even realize that it is the Australian capital.
sentences.zh: 大多数人甚至不知道它是澳大利亚的首都。

sentences.en: And then she gave this fun fact.
sentences.zh: 然后她分享了这个有趣的事实。
让我们听听这个有趣的事实。

sentences.en: The fun fact is, when they were deciding where they should put the capital of Australia,
sentences.zh: 有趣的事实是，当他们决定把澳大利亚首都设在哪里时，

sentences.en: they couldn't decide between Sydney or Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 他们在悉尼和墨尔本之间无法抉择。

sentences.en: And it was a really heated debate.
sentences.zh: 那是一场非常激烈的争论。

sentences.en: So, they literally built a whole new city in the middle of both of those cities.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们干脆在那两座城市中间新建了一座城市。

sentences.en: Just to make it the capital?
Well, Kimmy G got me curious about Canberra, and I started looking up details about the city.
sentences.zh: 基米·G让我对堪培拉产生了好奇，我开始查找关于这座城市的细节。

sentences.en: But the thing that really stood out to me is that there are all of these rumors, I guess,
sentences.zh: 但真正让我印象深刻的是，有各种传言，我想，

sentences.en: or stories, scuttlebutt, lore, lore, Canberra lore, maybe urban legends,
sentences.zh: 或者故事、流言、传说、堪培拉传说，也许是都市传说，

sentences.en: that there are these secret underground tunnels throughout the whole city.
sentences.zh: 说整个城市地下都有秘密隧道。

sentences.en: And I guess the rumors are that these tunnels have been used for, like, international espionage.
sentences.zh: 我猜传闻说这些隧道被用于国际间谍活动之类的。

sentences.en: So, I digged some more, and I think most of the rumors have been debunked.
sentences.zh: 所以我又深挖了一下，我觉得大部分传言都已经被辟谣了。

sentences.en: But then I started to think that the debunking was part of a conspiracy to hide the tunnels.
sentences.zh: 但后来我开始觉得，辟谣本身就是掩盖地道阴谋的一部分。

sentences.en: Like, I went so deep on the tunnels.
sentences.zh: 就像，我在地道这件事上钻研得太深了。

sentences.en: Lady, when Mom Detectives is in its, like, fifth season.
sentences.zh: Lady，等《妈妈侦探》拍到第五季的时候。

sentences.en: We need, like, an international episode.
We investigate the tunnels of Canberra.
sentences.zh: 我们要去调查堪培拉的地道。

sentences.en: Well, Lady, I knew that Canberra was the nation's capital because one of my best friends ever,
sentences.zh: Lady，我知道堪培拉是澳大利亚的首都，因为我最好的朋友之一，

sentences.en: Does he know about the tunnels?
We can get to the bottom of it right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就能把这件事查个水落石出。

sentences.en: We're going to call my friend, Michael Peters, also known as Micah.
sentences.zh: 我们要给我的朋友Michael Peters打电话，也就是Micah。

sentences.en: We're calling you from the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们正在播客节目里给你打电话。

sentences.en: We have a random question for you about Canberra, your hometown.
sentences.zh: 我们有个关于你家乡堪培拉的问题想问你。

sentences.en: Here is what I need to know.
Is it true that there's an elaborate tunnel system underneath the city that is used for espionage?
sentences.zh: 传闻说城市下面有一个用于间谍活动的复杂地道系统，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: I heard that there were tunnels underneath the Parliament House.
sentences.zh: 我听说议会大厦下面确实有地道。

sentences.en: Because, you know, the whole government sits in Canberra.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，整个政府都在堪培拉办公。

sentences.en: I don't know about secret spy tunnels.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道有什么秘密间谍地道。

sentences.en: So, I was able to confirm that there are little tunnels under the Parliament House.
sentences.zh: 所以我确认了议会大厦下面确实有一些小地道。

sentences.en: But I read this rumor that their secret passageways go all the way under Lake Burley Griffin.
sentences.zh: 但我读到的传言说，那些秘密通道一直延伸到了伯利格里芬湖下面。

sentences.en: I did not know that, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我之前确实不知道。

sentences.en: You want to tell them what you told me last night, what Canberra is known for?
sentences.zh: 你想告诉他们你昨晚跟我说的，堪培拉以什么闻名吗？

sentences.en: Well, Canberra is, you know, the capital of Australia.
sentences.zh: 嗯，堪培拉是澳大利亚的首都。
就像澳大利亚的华盛顿特区一样。

sentences.en: And it's also famous because it's where they make all the porn in Australia.
sentences.zh: 而且它之所以出名，是因为澳大利亚所有的色情片都是在那里制作的。

sentences.en: It's the Van Nuys of Australia.
sentences.zh: 它就是澳大利亚的范奈斯。

sentences.en: And I'm pretty sure we're also the only state, because it's a territory like D.C., the Australian capital territory, where you're allowed to have fireworks.
sentences.zh: 而且我很确定我们也是唯一一个州——因为它像华盛顿特区一样是个领地，即澳大利亚首都领地——允许燃放烟花的地方。
看来堪培拉确实在不断升级啊。

sentences.en: But I think you can do that in other states, too.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在其他州也可以。

sentences.en: It's not like in the U.S.
All right, Mika, thank you so much for being our 411 call about Canberra.
sentences.zh: 好的，米卡，非常感谢你为我们提供关于堪培拉的资讯。
没错，我们的堪培拉专家。

sentences.en: Well, we learned a lot of things we didn't think we were going to learn about Canberra.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们了解到了很多关于堪培拉的知识，这完全出乎我们的意料。

sentences.en: Yes, we still are unsure about the tunnels, but I'll tell you what, this episode of Mom Detectives just got more fun.
sentences.zh: 是的，虽然我们对隧道的事还不确定，但我跟你说，这集《妈妈侦探》变得更有趣了。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a lot that the Mom Detectives are going to see when we go there.
sentences.zh: 我是说，等我们去那里的时候，妈妈侦探们会看到很多东西。
她们会偶然发现很多东西。

sentences.en: Let's move to fast fact number three.
sentences.zh: 让我们进入第三个速览事实。

sentences.en: It's just a little location breakdown.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个小小的地点介绍。

sentences.en: Our final storyline of this episode is going to have Dwight going to the Steamtown Mall.
sentences.zh: 本集的最后一条故事线是德怀特去蒸汽镇购物中心。

sentences.en: We went to the Burbank Town Center Mall to shoot this.
sentences.zh: 我们是在伯班克市中心购物中心拍摄的这一段。

sentences.en: And that precious heirloom store that was created from scratch by our set decorating crew headed by Steve Rothstein.
sentences.zh: 还有那家由史蒂夫·罗斯坦领导的布景装饰团队从零开始打造的珍贵传家宝商店。

sentences.en: They used an empty store space on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 他们利用了二楼的一个空置店面。

sentences.en: And Randy shared with me that the original outline for this episode, like it never even made it into a script, originally had some scenes in a food court.
sentences.zh: 兰迪跟我分享说，这一集的原始大纲，甚至都没写进剧本里，原本在美食广场有一些场景。

sentences.en: And so, you know, they start prepping the episode long before we shoot it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他们在我们拍摄之前很久就开始筹备这一集了。

sentences.en: So, our locations manager, Kyle Alexander, actually had to find an empty store that we could dress that was also next to a food court.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的外景经理凯尔·亚历山大，实际上不得不找一家我们可以布置的空店面，而且还得挨着美食广场。

sentences.en: We never used the food court, but pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 我们最后没用上那个美食广场，但这真的很了不起。

sentences.en: I mean, just another example of how they have to, like, always be ready.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这只是他们必须时刻准备着的一个例子。

sentences.en: And then maybe we didn't even need it.
sentences.zh: 而且可能我们根本就不需要它。

sentences.en: But, lady, that's all I got.
sentences.zh: 但是，女士，我能说的就这些了。

sentences.en: Well, before we get into this episode, I have a little something.
sentences.zh: 好了，在进入这一集之前，我有个小东西要分享。

sentences.en: I wanted to share something from one of our Office Ladies listeners.
sentences.zh: 我想分享一位《办公室女士》听众发来的东西。

sentences.en: A lot of you might have heard of Elise Myers.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人可能听说过伊莉斯·迈尔斯。

sentences.en: And if you don't, go find her on Instagram or on the tickety-talk, as I call it.
sentences.zh: 如果没听说过，去Instagram或者我称之为“滴答谈”的平台上找她。

sentences.en: I'm following Elise on Instagram, and I love her.
sentences.zh: 我在Instagram上关注了伊莉斯，我超爱她。

sentences.en: She is a delight and brings absolute joy to the world.
sentences.zh: 她是个可爱的人，给这个世界带来了纯粹的快乐。

sentences.en: I mean, two words, Taco Bell.
But, you guys, she's also a fantastic singer.
sentences.zh: 但是，伙计们，她也是位出色的歌手。

sentences.en: And when I jokingly said on the podcast, can someone write a Whispers in the Breakroom song
sentences.zh: 当我在播客里开玩笑说，有没有人能写一首《休息室里的私语》之歌时，

sentences.en: when we were talking about cover-up, she did it.
sentences.zh: 当时我们在聊掩盖真相的话题，她真的写了。

sentences.en: And you got to hear it.
I overheard that Kelly's Birkin bag is actually fake, and that Michael can't remember his own
sentences.zh: 我无意中听到凯利的铂金包其实是假的，迈克尔记不住自己的

sentences.en: middle name, and that Andy is always two hours late.
sentences.zh: 中间名，还有安迪总是迟到两个小时。

sentences.en: These are the whispers in the breakroom.
sentences.zh: 这些就是休息室里的私语。

sentences.en: I heard that Meredith turned her desk into a minibar, and that Stanley schedules meetings and just sits in his car.
sentences.zh: 我听说梅雷迪斯把她的办公桌变成了迷你吧，斯坦利安排了会议却只是坐在车里。

sentences.en: And that Ryan didn't graduate with a master's degree.
sentences.zh: 还有瑞安根本没拿到硕士学位。

sentences.en: At least that's what I heard, but you didn't hear it from me.
sentences.zh: 至少我是这么听说的，但你可别说是我说的。

sentences.en: These are the whispers in the breakroom.
sentences.zh: 这些就是休息室里的私语。

sentences.en: If you want to know what's going on and you want it to come to you, the whispers in the breakroom.
sentences.zh: 如果你想知道发生了什么，又想让消息自动找上门，那就听休息室里的私语。

sentences.en: Just stick around long enough and learn a thing or two.
sentences.zh: 只要待得够久，你总能学到一两件事。

sentences.en: And that was Whispers in the Breakroom.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《休息室里的私语》。

sentences.en: Back to you, Angela and Jenna.
sentences.zh: 回到你们那里，安吉拉和珍娜。

sentences.en: When I saw that, you know, I follow her on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 当我看到那个视频时，你知道，我在Instagram上关注她。

sentences.en: And when I saw that, I was like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 当我看到的时候，我心想，天哪。
然后你就给我发短信了。

sentences.en: It was like a simultaneous thing where we were like, oh, my gosh, we're seeing this.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎是同时反应过来的，都在想，天哪，我们看到了这个。

sentences.en: Elise, I love so much about that song.
sentences.zh: 伊莉斯，我太喜欢这首歌里的很多地方了。

sentences.en: It also kind of reminded me of when, like, Dolly Parton would harmonize with Emmylou Harris and Linda Ronstadt.
sentences.zh: 它还让我想起了多莉·帕顿和埃米卢·哈里斯以及琳达·朗斯塔特合唱的时候。

sentences.en: But you're doing it all with yourself.
sentences.zh: 但你是自己一个人完成了所有的和声。

sentences.en: It's like my brain doesn't even understand how you do it.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑甚至无法理解你是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: Thank you for letting us play that on Office Ladies, Elise.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你让我们在《办公室女士》节目里播放这段录音，伊莉斯。

sentences.en: On that delightful note, let's take a break.
sentences.zh: 带着这份愉悦的心情，我们先休息一下。

sentences.en: Because when we come back, Jim and Pam are late to work.
sentences.zh: 因为回来之后，吉姆和帕姆上班迟到了。

sentences.en: Well, we are back and Dwight is, he's shaming Jim and Pam because they're late again.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们回来了，德怀特正在羞辱吉姆和帕姆，因为他们又迟到了。

sentences.en: You know, because Jim had to open that bathroom door a while back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为吉姆之前不得不去开那扇洗手间的门。

sentences.en: They didn't get into the daycare that's close to Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 他们没能进邓德·米夫林公司附近的那家托儿所。

sentences.en: And now they have to drive all the way across town.
sentences.zh: 现在他们得开车穿过整个城市。
他就像是说，嘿，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: There is a daycare center right here in this very building.
sentences.zh: 就在这栋楼里就有一家托儿所。

sentences.en: Dwight is going to give Jim and Pam a whole tour.
sentences.zh: 德怀特要带吉姆和帕姆参观一番。

sentences.en: The Sesame Avenue daycare for infants and toddlers, where Moe's has apparently been painting in the dark with a cabbage patch doll strapped to his chest,
sentences.zh: “芝麻街”婴幼儿托儿所，莫显然一直在那儿摸黑画画，胸前还绑着一个卷心菜娃娃，

sentences.en: is located in the former Michael Scott Paper Company.
sentences.zh: 它就开在以前的迈克尔·斯科特造纸公司旧址。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I thought I would break down the special features of the Sesame Avenue daycare center for infants and toddlers.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我想我得详细介绍一下“芝麻街”婴幼儿托儿所的特色设施。

sentences.en: According to Dwight, this is what your child's experience will include.
sentences.zh: 据德怀特所说，你孩子在这里的体验将包括这些内容。

sentences.en: A language skills and cognitive development area, which is just an eye chart on the old rusty shower.
sentences.zh: 一个语言技能和认知发展区，其实就是在生锈的旧淋浴间上贴了一张视力表。

sentences.en: There is one blue bouncy ball on an otherwise empty wire shelf.
sentences.zh: 在一个空荡荡的铁丝架上放着一个蓝色弹力球。

sentences.en: A magical toy box that has plastic forks and knives.
sentences.zh: 一个装有塑料叉子和刀子的神奇玩具箱。

sentences.en: He was very embarrassed by that.
And one is for a possible plant.
sentences.zh: 还有一个是用来种植物的。

sentences.en: And for those of you who love a good background catch, if you go to 45 seconds, the cabbage patch doll strapped to Moe's chest only has one red shoe on,
sentences.zh: 对于那些喜欢寻找背景细节的观众，如果你看到45秒处，莫胸前绑着的那个卷心菜娃娃只穿了一只红鞋，

sentences.en: and the other foot just has a sock.
Did you have cabbage patch kids when you were younger?
sentences.zh: 你小时候有卷心菜娃娃吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I was overseas, and I came stateside, and everyone had one.
sentences.zh: 噢，我那时在国外，后来回到国内，发现每个人都有一个。

sentences.en: And I was like, I need this in my life.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，我的生活里也需要一个。

sentences.en: This was such a big deal.
I had two cabbage patch kids, and I remember their names so clearly.
sentences.zh: 我有两个卷心菜娃娃，我清楚地记得它们的名字。
克里斯汀·玛丽和凯西·亚历山大。

sentences.en: Casey Alexander had curly auburn hair, and Christine Marie had blonde ponytails.
sentences.zh: 凯西·亚历山大留着红褐色的卷发，克里斯汀·玛丽扎着金色的马尾辫。

sentences.en: Mine had blonde hair with some freckles.
sentences.zh: 我的那个是金发，还有些雀斑。

sentences.en: I got her late in the game, and she clearly didn't make a stamp on me.
sentences.zh: 我是在后期才认识她的，她显然没给我留下什么深刻印象。

sentences.en: You remember I was trying to get Mandy Moore to name her son Casey Alexander in honor?
sentences.zh: 你还记得我曾试图让曼迪·摩尔给她的儿子取名为凯西·亚历山大，以示纪念吗？

sentences.en: I don't know why she didn't listen to you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她为什么没听你的。

sentences.en: Well, she has a second baby coming.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她又要生第二个孩子了。

sentences.en: Maybe she'll take my advice this time.
sentences.zh: 也许这次她会听取我的建议。

sentences.en: Mandy, Casey Alexander, it's waiting for you.
sentences.zh: 曼迪，凯西·亚历山大，这个名字在等着你呢。

sentences.en: Although, let's point out, none of your children are named Casey Alexander.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们得指出，你的孩子里也没有叫凯西·亚历山大的。

sentences.en: Well, listen, I had to ask Randy a question when I saw this cold open, Angela.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听着，安吉拉，当我看到这个开场时，我不得不问兰迪一个问题。

sentences.en: I needed to know, did they have to clean out this room again?
sentences.zh: 我需要知道，他们是不是又得把这个房间清理一遍？
因为这里本来是储藏室。

sentences.en: Quote, we had finally gotten smarter and left the room empty and found a different place for post-production storage.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：我们终于变聪明了，把房间空了出来，给后期制作找了个别的地方存放东西。

sentences.en: He was just so fed up.
Randy also shared with me that Mike Schur, who plays Moe's, was insanely busy over at Parks and Rec,
sentences.zh: 兰迪还告诉我，饰演莫斯的迈克·舒尔当时在《公园与游憩》剧组忙得不可开交，

sentences.en: and that the writers of the office would often try to put Moe's in an episode,
sentences.zh: 而《办公室》的编剧们经常想在某一集里安排莫斯出场，

sentences.en: and then Randy would go check with Mike's schedule, and then he wouldn't be able to do it,
sentences.zh: 然后兰迪就会去核对迈克的档期，结果他没空，

sentences.en: and they would have to take Moe's out.
sentences.zh: 他们就不得不把莫斯的戏份删掉。
这种情况发生过很多次。

sentences.en: So Randy said, finally, finally, Mike was like, yeah, my schedule's totally clear that day.
sentences.zh: 所以兰迪说，终于，终于，迈克说，好啊，我那天档期完全空着。

sentences.en: I can come drop a cabbage patch to my cheSt.
sentences.zh: 我可以过来把卷心菜娃娃抱在怀里。

sentences.en: Yes, and everyone was so excited because we got to have Moe's back.
sentences.zh: 没错，大家都特别兴奋，因为我们终于能让莫斯回归了。

sentences.en: Well, this episode opens with Toby and Michael sitting opposite one another in the break room.
sentences.zh: 这一集开场时，托比和迈克坐在休息室里相对而坐。
他们正在进行一场激烈的对视。

sentences.en: Michael looks like the Emperor, you know, in Star Wars when he's, like, given that death look.
sentences.zh: 迈克看起来就像《星球大战》里的皇帝，你知道的，就是那种死亡凝视。

sentences.en: I wouldn't know that because I haven't seen those filMs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，因为我没看过那些电影。

sentences.en: I know you're thinking of Emperor Palpatine.
sentences.zh: 我知道你指的是帕尔帕廷皇帝。

sentences.en: Well, that's Michael in this opening scene.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那就是这一开场戏里的迈克。

sentences.en: We had a fan catch from Zach K from Acton, Ontario, Canada, who said,
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位来自加拿大安大略省阿克顿的粉丝扎克·K的反馈，他说，

sentences.en: Not really a question, but a comment.
sentences.zh: 这不算是个问题，只是个评论。

sentences.en: I love how this episode begins with 15 seconds, yes, I counted it, of silence before any dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一集开头那15秒的沉默，没错，我数过了，在任何对话开始之前。

sentences.en: This must be a record for the longest silence in the show.
sentences.zh: 这一定是全剧最长沉默纪录了。

sentences.en: I'm like, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，你在说什么呢？

sentences.en: I wrote about it in a book.
Welcome to my summer cold, everyone.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到我的夏季感冒时间，各位。

sentences.en: But yes, I have to say, I thought it was a pretty badass move that the episode opens with so much silence.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我不得不说，我觉得这一集一开场就用了那么长时间的静默，真是个非常酷的举动。

sentences.en: Well, I love how seriously Toby has taken this chance to help Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很喜欢托比对待这次帮助迈克尔的机会有多认真。

sentences.en: He moves a small love seat.
sentences.zh: 他搬来了一个小双人沙发。

sentences.en: He puts a chair in there, a little coffee table.
sentences.zh: 他在那儿放了一把椅子，还有一张小咖啡桌。

sentences.en: He has a plant, a box of Kleenex.
sentences.zh: 他还有一盆植物，一盒纸巾。

sentences.en: He's going to, like, get down to business and have therapy in the break room.
sentences.zh: 他打算要在休息室里认真地进行心理辅导。

sentences.en: We had some fan questions about this setup.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一些粉丝关于这个布置的问题。

sentences.en: The first one's from Nicole Q from Bowie, Maryland, who would like to know, where did Toby get these sofas from for the setup?
sentences.zh: 第一个问题来自马里兰州鲍伊市的妮可·Q，她想知道，托比是从哪儿弄来这些沙发进行布置的？

sentences.en: They're in the annex in the little hallway.
sentences.zh: 它们就在侧厅的小走廊里。

sentences.en: Oh, I was thinking they were from front reception.
sentences.zh: 哦，我原以为它们是从前台接待处搬来的。

sentences.en: Because remember, in the injury, Michael moves the couch from front reception into the conference room.
sentences.zh: 因为记得吗，在“受伤”那一集里，迈克尔把前台的沙发搬进了会议室。

sentences.en: I thought they were the ones that were in the annex little lobby area.
sentences.zh: 我以为它们是侧厅小大堂里的那些。

sentences.en: Not as big of a move.
Now we have a fan catch from Emily J in Ohio, who has some comments about the little plant that you said Toby put on the table.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有一个来自俄亥俄州艾米丽·J的粉丝发现，她对你提到的托比放在桌上的那盆小植物有一些评论。

sentences.en: Emily's theory is that the plant looks exactly like the one that died when Pam was on maternity leave, and Emily thinks maybe Toby brought it back to life just to impress Pam.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽的理论是，那盆植物看起来和帕姆休产假时死掉的那盆一模一样，艾米丽觉得托比可能是为了给帕姆留下好印象才把它救活的。

sentences.en: I sort of just thought Toby took Pam's plant.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是觉得托比拿走了帕姆的植物。

sentences.en: I was like, Pam, can I borrow this for today?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，帕姆，我今天能借用一下这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I wasn't sure because Pam has a different plant on her desk now.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我不确定，因为帕姆现在桌上有一盆不同的植物。

sentences.en: You know the one with the bow?
sentences.zh: 你知道那盆带蝴蝶结的吗？

sentences.en: Oh, it looks almost like bamboo or something.
sentences.zh: 哦，它看起来几乎像是竹子之类的。

sentences.en: So I don't know where this ivy plant came from.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道这盆常春藤是从哪儿来的。

sentences.en: Well, Emily, it definitely looks like a Pam plant.
sentences.zh: 嗯，艾米丽，它看起来绝对像是帕姆的植物。

sentences.en: Dwight is going to just burst into the bullpen, telling everyone they must boycott Steamtown Mall.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我们这辈子很有可能会去那个商场滑一次雪。

sentences.zh: 吉姆想知道，是不是发生了什么事？

sentences.zh: 回到心理咨询休息室，托比真的在努力与迈克尔建立联系，试图让他分享自己的事情。

sentences.en: And Michael is just saying a whole bunch of baloney to Toby, trying to get a rise out of him.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔只是在对托比胡说八道，试图激怒他。

sentences.zh: 在这一集中，是从菲利斯开始的。

sentences.zh: 她说，我很高兴迈克尔能去寻求帮助。

sentences.en: He has a lot of issues, and he's stupid.
sentences.zh: 他有很多问题，而且他很蠢。
这个桥段本应继续下去的。

sentences.en: Here are a few from the shooting draft.

这些是备选拍摄的素材。

sentences.en: See if you can guess who said which talking head.
sentences.zh: 看看你们能不能猜出是谁说了哪段采访词。

sentences.zh: 萨姆、卡西、珍娜，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Michael isn't complex enough to need therapy.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔还没复杂到需要心理咨询的地步。

sentences.zh: 难道就不能有人冷静地向他解释他哪里出了问题吗？

sentences.zh: 我觉得那句台词念得太棒了。

sentences.en: Angela does have one, and I thought rather than me reading it, let's just play it the way I said it.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉确实有一段，我觉得与其让我读出来，不如直接播放我当时录的版本。

sentences.en: Talking about how many feelings you have is a form of bragging.
sentences.zh: 谈论你有多少感受是一种炫耀。

sentences.zh: 她对每个人都在分享自己的感受感到非常厌烦。

sentences.en: And Ryan has one that comes later in the episode.
sentences.zh: 瑞安也有一段，出现在这一集的后面。

sentences.en: Well, we had a fan question from Sarah L.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们收到了一位来自德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的粉丝莎拉·L的提问，

sentences.en: in San Antonio, Texas, who said,
I would love to know if there is a backstory as to why Michael hates Toby so much.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道迈克尔为什么那么讨厌托比，这背后有什么故事吗？

sentences.en: I feel like Michael has such a blind affection for his employees that there must be something
sentences.zh: 我觉得迈克尔对他员工的爱护简直到了盲目的地步，所以他讨厌托比一定有

sentences.en: more to his hatred for Toby that explains it.

sentences.zh: 还是说这只是经理讨厌人力资源部的经典桥段？

sentences.en: And Michael has a line when he's meeting Holly for the first time.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔在第一次见到霍莉时说过一句台词。

sentences.en: And he says that his job is to, quote, make the office fun, while HR's job is to make the office lame.
sentences.zh: 他说他的工作是，引用一下，让办公室变得有趣，而人力资源部的工作是让办公室变得无聊。

sentences.en: And we kind of knew that.
sentences.zh: 我们其实也知道这一点。

sentences.en: But then I found this amazing interview with Paul Lieberstein, where he talks about this.
sentences.zh: 但我后来找到了保罗·李伯斯坦的一个精彩采访，他在里面谈到了这件事。

sentences.en: How did they come up with, in the writer's room, this dynamic of Michael hating Toby so much?
sentences.zh: 编剧室当初是怎么想出迈克尔如此讨厌托比这种设定的呢？

sentences.en: And he said that Michael's hatred of Toby goes back to a deleted scene from the Alliance.
sentences.zh: 他说迈克尔对托比的仇恨可以追溯到《联盟》那一集里的一段删减片段。

sentences.en: This is where they found this, like, true hatred of Toby.
sentences.zh: 他们就是在那里发现了这种对托比真正的仇恨。

sentences.en: In the scene, Toby is coming in to sign Meredith's birthday card.
sentences.zh: 在那个场景里，托比进来给梅雷迪思的生日贺卡签名。

sentences.en: And Paul said, I just go in, write something quickly, and leave.
sentences.zh: 保罗说，我当时就是走进去，随便写点什么，然后离开。

sentences.en: But when they were shooting the scene, I guess it took Paul a long time to physically write down what he was going to write down.
sentences.zh: 但在拍摄那个场景时，我猜保罗花了好长时间才写完他要写的东西。

sentences.en: I have a memory of this, that he was writing in the card, and it took a bit.
sentences.zh: 我记得这件事，他当时在卡片上写字，花了一点时间。

sentences.en: Paul said, I could just feel him watching me, and I could feel this hatred burning.
sentences.zh: 保罗说，我能感觉到他在盯着我看，我能感觉到那种燃烧的仇恨。

sentences.en: And he said that Steve told him afterwards that it was in that moment that he decided, as Michael, to hate Toby.
sentences.zh: 他说史蒂夫事后告诉他，就是在那一刻，他决定以迈克尔的身份去讨厌托比。

sentences.en: And then Paul said, it's really terrifying to act with Steve because he misses nothing.
sentences.zh: 保罗还说，和史蒂夫演对手戏真的很可怕，因为他什么细节都不会放过。

sentences.en: And that was when they ran with it, that Paul went to the writers and said, Michael hates Toby.
sentences.zh: 于是他们就顺着这个思路演下去了，保罗跑去告诉编剧们，迈克尔讨厌托比。

sentences.en: Because you know, if Jim took a long time to write a message, he would have all the patience in the world.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，如果吉姆花很长时间写留言，他会有全世界的耐心。

sentences.en: But Toby not really knowing what to write and taking a bit.
sentences.zh: 但托比不知道写什么，还磨磨蹭蹭的。

sentences.en: And then, of course, that led to one of my favorite lines, I hate so much about the way you choose to be.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也引出了我最喜欢的台词之一：我非常讨厌你选择成为的那种人。

sentences.en: Which is what sums it all up.
We're about to start a whole new story arc for Pam.
sentences.zh: 我们马上要开启帕姆的一个全新故事线了。

sentences.en: She's not having a great sales day.
sentences.zh: 她今天的销售业绩不太好。

sentences.en: She's just going to own that she sucks at it.
sentences.zh: 她决定坦然接受自己不擅长销售的事实。

sentences.en: She, like, puts her head on her desk.
We had a fan question from Cassandra P.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位来自威斯康星州麦迪逊市的粉丝卡桑德拉·P的提问，

sentences.en: this is one of my favorite Office episodes, and if I had an Angela-style note card to describe this episode, I would call it Full Pam.
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的《办公室》剧集之一，如果我有一张安吉拉风格的卡片来描述这一集，我会称之为“完全的帕姆”。
噢，我太喜欢这个说法了！

sentences.en: Pam truly becomes the main character in this episode, and it sets her up for empowerment and strength for the rest of the series.
sentences.zh: 帕姆在这一集中真正成为了主角，这为她后续剧集中的赋权和成长奠定了基础。

sentences.en: Also, this season, Pam's makeup is 100% on point.
sentences.zh: 另外，这一季帕姆的妆容简直完美。

sentences.en: Pam got really good with eyeliner.
I don't know what happened to her over the summer.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她那个暑假经历了什么。

sentences.en: Like we said, I got married over the summer, so I was just glowing.
sentences.zh: 就像我们说的，我那个暑假结婚了，所以整个人都在散发光彩。

sentences.en: I think maybe that's part of it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那可能也是原因之一。

sentences.en: You were just a happy person.
sentences.zh: 你当时就是一个幸福的人。

sentences.en: Oh, what's up next is John Krasinski breaking a lot.
sentences.zh: 噢，接下来是约翰·卡拉辛斯基笑场了。

sentences.en: He is so tickled by Andy coming up to Dwight.
sentences.zh: 安迪走向德怀特的那一幕让他觉得太好笑了。

sentences.zh: 约翰看着艾德，背景里他明显开始笑场了。

sentences.zh: 嗯，我们发现了德怀特为什么要抵制蒸汽镇购物中心的原因。

sentences.en: It's because he went there with Moe's, and he went to Precious Heirlooms, and they wouldn't let him in.
sentences.zh: 因为他当时和莫斯一起去那儿，想进“珍贵传家宝”店，结果被拒之门外。

sentences.en: Yeah, he saw this amazing wizard holding a crystal.
sentences.zh: 对，他看到了一个拿着水晶的超酷巫师。

sentences.en: Yeah, he wanted this nice thing.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他想要那个好东西。

sentences.zh: 他很少给自己买什么好东西。

sentences.en: He wanted it, and they denied him entry.
sentences.zh: 他想要那个东西，结果被拒绝入内。

sentences.en: Kelly says, you need a pretty woman there, asses.
sentences.zh: 凯莉说，你们得带个美女去，混蛋们。

sentences.en: Well, except Creed, who says they should start their own mall.
sentences.zh: 除了克里德，他说他们应该自己开个购物中心。

sentences.zh: 吉姆提议和德怀特一起回店里给他们点教训。

sentences.en: Andy's going to start off with a talking head, where he says, did you assume that I would automatically side with the rich, snobby shop owner?
sentences.zh: 安迪先是有一个采访镜头，他说，你是不是以为我会自动站在那个有钱、势利的店主那边？

sentences.en: He starts taking off his fancy cufflinks and throwing them, takes off his tie clip.
sentences.zh: 他开始摘下昂贵的袖扣扔掉，又摘下了领带夹。

sentences.zh: 安迪当时还有一个关于糖果袋的备选方案。

sentences.en: Nobody's getting the top of their skull sliced off today.
sentences.zh: 今天没人会把头盖骨给削下来。

sentences.en: I love that Andy is a Legally Blonde fan.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢安迪是《律政俏佳人》粉丝这一点。

sentences.en: This leads into my personal favorite talking head.
sentences.zh: 这引出了我个人最喜欢的采访片段。

sentences.en: And all they're trying to do is tell us the famous scene from Pretty Woman, where Julia Roberts gets her revenge on the snooty shop owner.
sentences.zh: 他们都在试图重现《风月俏佳人》里的经典桥段，就是朱莉娅·罗伯茨向那个势利眼的店主复仇的那一段。

sentences.zh: 她想到了一个绝妙的主意。

sentences.zh: 我们回来了，有个男人走进办公室找行政主管，帕姆立刻精神起来了。

sentences.zh: 我们不需要你的百叶窗，也不需要你的窗帘装饰。
在8分40秒的时候，我被抓包了。

sentences.zh: 对了，我想告诉大家，我们今天有位客串明星在场。

sentences.zh: 文森特·安杰洛，饰演推销员的那位，他曾出演过《绝望主妇》、《实习医生格蕾》、《公园与游憩》和《豪斯医生》。

sentences.zh: 我不知道发现某人演过《神探阿蒙》还是《豪斯医生》更让我开心。

sentences.en: You just like seeing a guest star in the house.
sentences.zh: 你就是喜欢看到有客串明星在场。

sentences.zh: 我还喜欢追踪演员是否在《法律与秩序》里演过不止一个角色。

sentences.zh: 第一种，你可以等一个空缺，一份新工作。

sentences.zh: 她显然是想从奥斯卡那儿套出这个职位合理的薪水是多少。

sentences.en: The first one is from Kelly M.
sentences.zh: 第一封来自澳大利亚墨尔本的凯莉·M。

sentences.en: a couple of years ago, I was inspired by Pam's storyline in this episode
sentences.zh: 几年前，我受到了这一集中帕姆剧情的启发，

sentences.en: where she just starts telling people she's the office administrator.
sentences.zh: 就是她开始告诉别人她是办公室行政主管的那段。

sentences.zh: 她说，我在一所学校工作。

sentences.zh: 几年前，我决定我们真的很需要一位可持续发展协调员。

sentences.en: But it's quite hard to get new roles off the ground because of budgets and things.
sentences.zh: 但因为预算之类的原因，很难开展新职位。

sentences.zh: 所以我决定直接开始自称可持续发展协调员。
